title: Without See Financial Data the notice does not show
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a category A part line.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
  4. Pick customer B.
  5. Click Update Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer, Split Work Order and Back to Work Orders.

Step 3:

  • The Change Customer dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer B is picked.

Step 5:

  • Work order 1 now shows customer B.
  • No notice about lines priced for the previous customer shows.
